description:
In this episode of The Brief: Season 2, we challenged photographer and videographer @aawoza to revisit his San Francisco photo book concept from 2021 and fully realize it today as a completed project. Watch him work across the Creative Cloud ecosystem, including Lightroom, Photoshop, Adobe Stock, and InDesign, to complete the brief.

Watch this space to see who takes on The Brief next week! 👀
